data.name: TBC1D7
data.description: Third constitutive subunit of the TSC complex; its loss weakens but does not abolish TSC1-TSC2 function.
data.description_beginner: A third, less essential building block of the TSC brake complex. Losing it weakens the TSC1/TSC2 brake on mTORC1 but doesn't fully knock it out.

studies.title: TBC1D7 is a third subunit of the TSC1-TSC2 complex upstream of mTORC1
studies.authors: Dibble CC; Manning BD et al.

evidence.label: Molecular — cells, biochemistry, structure
evidence.note: this describes the kind of study, not its quality

studies.finding: TBC1D7 is the third core subunit of the TSC1-TSC2 complex regulating Rheb/mTORC1.

relations.mechanism: TBC1D7 is the third, often-forgotten subunit of the TSC complex; losing it weakens the brake without removing it.
relations.mechanism_beginner: TBC1D7 is a smaller, easy-to-miss third piece of the TSC brake; losing it weakens the brake without removing it.
